subject: NULL address pointer and message tag content
notes: kb/Work PB1427 LANDED (wave 68 Y). SR1 'This item may be used only in the following cases, depending upon the associated data item's class' (cite.py OK 1)); a) 'it may be used only as a sending operand in an INITIALIZE or a SET statement; as an argument in a program-prototype format CALL statement, a function-prototype format function activation, or a method invocation; or in a pointer-or-object-reference relation condition' (cite.py OK 1) a)). ONE screen: every operand slot binds NULL through NonNumericLiteralOperand, which refuses it (COBOL2576), except the SR1 contexts, which bind through NullAdmittingOperand (INITIALIZE REPLACING, CALL / function-prototype / INVOKE arguments, relation and EVALUATE operands; SET through its own grammar senders). Measured on the w68y build: STRING NULL, INSPECT ... FOR ALL NULL, INSPECT REPLACING, UNSTRING DELIMITED BY NULL, FUNCTION LENGTH(NULL), ADD NULL, COMPUTE = NULL, MOVE NULL, DISPLAY NULL, STOP RUN WITH ERROR STATUS NULL, concatenation, NULL = NULL each COBOL2576 (were run as LOW-VALUE; NULL = NULL crashed codegen); INITIALIZE P/PP/O REPLACING ... BY NULL, SET, IF P = NULL, EVALUATE P WHEN NULL and the CALL / FUNCTION / INVOKE argument slots run (goldens). The per-statement arms 0809/1694/1704 for NULL are gone. SR1 b) (message-tag) has no reachable subject: USAGE MESSAGE-TAG is DECLINED non-support (COBOL1943, Annex A.3 item 4).
